blocks.text:
Bogotá welcomes you with the gold of pre-Columbian civilisations and views from Monserrate. In the Coffee Region, the route continues past wax palms and the colourful streets of Salento, with a tasting at El Ocaso farm. After zip lining and a horseback ride, you will fly to Cartagena and then spend 3 nights on San Andrés. The final part of the journey takes you to Medellín, Comuna 13 and Guatapé.
